svg.title: iOS · Collection detail (timeline builder) · landscape
svg.desc: Mirrors App/CollectionDetailView.swift (wideLayout, MissingClipsBanner, clipRow, rowSubtitle) over App/CollectionAvailability.swift: past 560pt of width the builder splits — preview left, controls right. The left column (min(46% of width, 420pt)) vertically centres the crop surface at up to (column−20)×(height−120); a tall canvas (9:16 · 3:4) gets the room it needs, which is the point of rotating. The preview wears its own controls exactly as portrait does (2026-08-31 rework): clip badge top-left, canvas menu chip bottom-right ON the media (bare-ratio menu, widest→tallest, first clip's shape marked), the honest-pixels HUD at its top while a crop drag is live — the caption that used to sit under the preview is GONE. The right column stacks: the compact meta line "0:19 · exports 2160×3840" alone on the top row (it is the wide layout's summary card), then the scroll region opening with the header row — TIMELINE · 2 CLIPS left, the Ken Burns tri-state (Off | Auto | Custom) right, same control as portrait — then the rows card (same 66pt clipRow as portrait, CROP badges and all). No Ken Burns card follows the timeline any more: Auto deals silently, Custom opens the options drawer as a POPOVER anchored to the control here (iPad/Mac; see collection-detail.kenburns-options.portrait.svg). With Ken Burns on, the framing bar sits under the preview and the identity frames (white start / amber end, ties + haloed arrow) draw exactly as collection-detail.kenburns.portrait.svg; macOS additionally puts 7pt corner grips on the active frame and resizes it by scroll wheel over the preview. The bottom row is dashed "+ Add clips" + "Export collection" (44pt, side by side). Same layout serves iPad and macOS (the 760×680 default window is wide enough). Known gap, tracked in docs/TODO.md: on iPad the floating tab bar pill overlays the bottom row's Add button. Status text and nav are the system's; the floating tab bar continues to overlay (drawn omitted here for clarity of the split — geometry as portrait). Drawn with the 9:16 crop state selected, at rest (no drag, so no HUD). 2026-09-26 — a clip on PicPlace and a still (plan §11 stage 3 rule 4 and §15 D4, code first, mirrored after sign-off): the SELECTED clip (row 1) is the one whose file is on PicPlace, not on this iPhone — the preview draws its still (posters/<blend id>.jpg) under the same crop frame, so nothing on the surface changes; its row wears an icloud glyph where the play glyph was and keeps its length, CROP badge, trim button and grip; a play, a trim / start point and Export ask first ("Download this clip?" · Download and Continue · Stay as Is — see collection-detail.portrait.svg). The scroll region opens, under the header, with the MissingClipsBanner (llCard, 12pt padding, 10pt above the rows): icloud 15 semibold secondary · "1 clip isn't on this iPhone" 13.5 semibold · "Playing, trimming and exporting need them here · 410 KB" 11.5 secondary · Download 13.5 semibold accent — then "Downloading from PicPlace…" with a spinner while they come down; "this iPad" / "this Mac" on those. The subtitle wraps at this drawing's 456pt column too — SwiftUI pushes "410" down beside "KB" rather than leave one word on a line (checked by laying the banner out headlessly); a real iPhone's landscape column, ≈350pt inside the safe area, breaks it "Playing, trimming and exporting / need them here · 410 KB". Row 2 is a STILL member (D4): a 3:4 photo's still — photo glyph over its thumbnail, "Still · 4.0s · gentle move", the ⏱ timer length menu in the trim button's seat — framed for this collection only, hence CROP 9:16 · CUSTOM. To make room the meta line and the header row sit at their code positions (meta 10pt under the nav, the header 12pt under it — 6–7pt higher than this file drew them before), the banner under the header and the rows card 70pt lower than before; row 2 still ends 5pt above the bottom row. The meta line's total is 15 + 4 s = 0:19.

g.text: Playing, trimming and exporting need them here ·
